headline: Recommended final passage of NIMCO site development agreements with Lansing Melbourne Group; approved contracts including $2,300,320 parking garage work.
summary: The committee approved 14 contracts, contract amendments, and change orders, ranging from $31,392 to $2,300,320. It also recommended final passage of agreements with Lansing Melbourne Group for the NIMCO site.
decisions: Approved a contract with Motorola Solutions, Inc. for system upgrades and services, not to exceed $318,732.35. Motion carried.
Approved an amendment with Cale America, Inc. for parking pay station connectivity, support, and warranty, not to exceed $31,392. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment #2 with Greenman-Pedersen, Inc. for oversight of parking garage project phases 2 and 3, not to exceed $117,455.30. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment #3 with Randall Paulson, Inc. for construction administration of the parking office, not to exceed $42,425. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment #3 with Whiting-Turner Contracting Company for build out of the parking department office in the Elm Street Garage, not to exceed $2,300,320. Motion carried.

Approved the annual renewal of a software subscription with Target Solutions Learning, LLC d/b/a Vector Solutions for Nashua Fire Rescue’s online training platform, not to exceed $79,546.29. Motion carried.
Approved a three-year contract with ADS Environmental Services for flow monitoring of the collection system, not to exceed $329,500. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment 2 with Resource Management, Inc. for biosolids management at the wastewater treatment facility, not to exceed $60,000. Motion carried.
Approved a contract with Bill’s World Class Cleaning for cleaning DPW, street and traffic, and wastewater facilities, not to exceed $90,000. Motion carried.
Approved Change Order No. 2 with Sunshine Paving for the 2026 Paving Program contract, not to exceed $630,000. Motion carried.
Awarded a construction contract to RWC Enterprises for the 2026 Sewer & Drain Improvement Project, not to exceed $749,395. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment No. 1 with IMEG, Inc. for engineering services for the 2026 Sewer & Drain Rehabilitation Program, not to exceed $388,000. Motion carried.
Approved Amendment No. 1 with IMEG, Inc. for construction engineering services for the 2025 CIPP Sewer Main Lining Project, not to exceed $118,935.50. Motion carried.
Approved an engineering contract with Hazen and Sawyer for tasks required by the EPA MS4 permit, not to exceed $149,156. Motion carried.

Recommended final passage of Resolution R-26-047, authorizing an amended and restated master development agreement and fourth amendment to the purchase and sale agreement with Lansing Melbourne Group, LLC for the NIMCO site. Motion carried.

UPDATED MEMO 7/8/26 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
To:  James Donchess, Mayor 
From:   T. Cummings, Director Administrative Services 
Cc:  Jill Stansfield Parking Manager 
 Liz Hannum, Director of Economic Development 
 
Date: June 23, 2026 
 
Re:  Communication – Amendment of Randall Paulson c ontract for the parking garage office 
design 
 
 
 
Randall Paulson Architects have completed the design of the parking garage office expansion. 
This amendment is for construction administration duties during the construction of the parking 
office. 
 
A copy of the Professional Engineering Services Contract Amendment related to the Parking 
Garage Office Expansion with Randall Paulson is attached, including the scope and fee. The total 
figure for this effort is $42,425.00. The source of funds is the Parking Garage Repair Bond 
created to implement the project. 
 
THANK YOU 
Administrative Services
UPDATED MEMO 7/8/26 
 
 
 
 
 
 
To:  James Donchess, Mayor 
From:  T. Cummings, Director Administrative Services 
Cc: Jill Stansfield Parking Manager 
 Liz Hannum, Director of Economic Development 
 
Date: June 23, 2026 
 
Re:  Communication – Amendment of GPI contract for the Parking Garage Owner’s Project 
Manager Contract 
 
 
 
GPI has been the owner’s project manager on the parking garage renovation project since 
February 2024. This amendment with allow them to continue oversite of the project on phases 2 
and 3 until the project’s completion.  
 
A copy of the Professional Engineering Services Contract Amendment related to the Parking 
Garage Renovation Project Management Services with GPI is attached, including the scope and 
fee. The total figure for this effort is $117,455.30. The source of funds is the Parking Garage 
Repair Bond created to implement the project. 
 
THANK YOU 
Administrative Services
UPDATED MEMO 7/8/26  
 
 
 
 
 
 
To:  James Donchess, Mayor 
From:   T. Cummings, Director Administrative Services 
Cc:  Jill Stansfield Parking Manager 
 Liz Hannum, Director of Economic Development 
 
Date: June 23, 2026 
 
Re:  Communication – Amendment of Whiting Turner co ntract for the parking garage phase 2 
 
 
 
Whiting Turner Constructions is in the process of performing the parking garage structural 
repairs on the Elm and High St garages. Attached is the GMP for phase 2 of the project. Phase 2 
will include the build out and renovation of the parking department office in the Elm St Garage. 
 
A copy of the Construction Services Contract Amendment related to the Parking Garage Repairs 
is attached, including the scope and fee. The total figure for this effort is $2,300,320.00. The 
source of funds is the Parking Garage Repair Bond created to implement the project. 
 
THANK YOU 
Administrative Services
